paragraphs: I'm a PMP-certified technical project and program management professional with 20+ years of experience leading programs, managing teams, coordinating stakeholders, and supporting technology adoption. My background combines organizational leadership, Agile project delivery, and hands-on independent AWS, Google Cloud, and AI projects.

I founded and directed JoeyDCares Rock Orchestra and Awesome Kids Program, managing operations, partnerships, staff, and program growth. At JoeyDCares, six Rockin' The Cause benefit concerts generated $42,000 in net proceeds donated to charities after expenses. At Awesome Kids, enrollment grew from 2 to 50+ students and monthly revenue increased from approximately $500 to $5,000.

I hold the PMP and AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional certifications, along with multiple Google Cloud credentials. I bring practical experience coordinating a client WordPress e-commerce project, using Jira and Agile workflows, and developing cloud and AI portfolio solutions. I'm interested in technical project management, program leadership, cloud initiatives, AI enablement, and technology implementation.
